label: Illustrative three-person Irish household resident; not a national average

sources.note: 2022 dwelling energy: electricity 4513 kWh; non-electric 12636 kWh.
2022 mean household size 2.74. This illustrative scenario uses three people to satisfy the existing integer household input, not the national mean.

limitations: National benchmark acceptance in Specification S7 remains unmet: representative travel, food, items and heating fuel mix have not been established.
CO2-only home energy proxies and global food/UK transport factors retain the limitations in data-sources.md.
An engine-derived annual reference value and engine parity verification are pending; no fabricated national total is published.

assumptions.transport: One petrol car occupant, 20 km/day for 230 days/year; illustrative, not NTA statistics.
assumptions.flight: Zero passenger.km/year is a scenario choice, not a national mean.
assumptions.food: 1 kg/day, 365 days; mass shares beef 0.1, chicken 0.1, tofu 0.1, rice 0.3, brassicas 0.4; illustrative basket, not a complete or nationally representative diet.
assumptions.home: 2022 SEAI mean dwelling electricity 4513 kWh and non-electric energy 12636 kWh allocated equally to three assumed residents. All non-electric energy treated as GCV natural gas is a proxy, not the observed Irish fuel mix.
assumptions.items: 5 kg primary paper per person/year is a scenario choice.

comparison.method: Use scenario.inputs with the existing client engine and GET /factors?version=2026-10-f1. No separate backend calculation engine.
